about: The Workbench icons of the OpenInvaders drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/openinvaders.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: a green invader over a cannon and a shield) is The AmiCradle Team's own, GPL-2 or later like the game; art/openinvaders.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. OpenInvaders-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, OpenInvaders.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-OpenInvaders and COPYING.txt.
